notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Shapeshifter.
description:
Cast Absorb Identity by paying {1}{U}, returning Mirror-Mad Phantasm to your hand from the battlefield, and causing each Shapeshifter you control to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate a Shapeshifter by paying {1}{U}, shuffling it into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.
